spec_match.rationale: Normalising dash coordinates with path-length: 100 and driving stroke-dasharray percentages is exactly the property's canonical use, and the generated CSS (including the keyframes variant) matches that contract.

interactive.rationale: Five shape presets, a draw-progress slider, stroke-width slider, animate/reset buttons and regenerated CSS output all drive the live SVG (assessed from code review and the rendered DOM; the controls were not driven in this session).

blurb_alignment.rationale: The index card promises shape selection plus slider/animated drawing via path-length normalisation — delivered.

edge_cases.rationale: No capability detection: in this browser (path-length unsupported — 4 of the 6 conformance assertions fail) style.pathLength is a silent no-op, so the dasharray falls back to user units and the slider yields repeating dash stripes instead of a progressive draw, with no notice that the rendering is wrong.

references.rationale: No chromestatus.com/feature/4861677550043136 link on the page — see-also lists only sibling concepts, violating invariant 3.

conformance.rationale: The feature suite probes the real property contract (unitless number, fractional, none, rejects <length>, SVG application, dasharray pairing) and honestly fails 4 of 6 here.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Cloud-fallback observation only, NOT browser-verified per auto-research.md §0 — headless Chromium 141 (full-page screenshot + DOM, not chrome-devtools-mcp): ghost heart renders, draw path at 0%, controls and CSS output present, conformance panel 2/4/0; slider, shape switching and the animate loop were not driven. chrome-devtools-mcp is unavailable in this cloud session (the auto-research.md section-0 blocker applies, so this is NOT browser verification): what was exercised is page load, full-page screenshot read, served/dumped DOM state and the /conformance/ route result; driving every control and capturing console/network evidence remains for an MCP-equipped session.

design_system.rationale: Variables throughout; .btn and .shape-btn set background and color together in both states.

accessibility.rationale: Sliders have real <label for> bindings and textual readouts, but shape buttons lack aria-pressed, the SVG's aria-label ('Svg stage SVG graphic') is uninformative, draw progress is not surfaced in a live region, and the animate loop ignores prefers-reduced-motion.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: The SVG caps at 500px and scales, controls wrap; clean at 1280px headless, ≈360px untested.

openQuestions.title: Detect path-length support — unsupported browsers currently render garbage stripes
openQuestions.detail: When CSS.supports('path-length','100') is false (this browser), style.pathLength no-ops and stroke-dasharray '50 51' is interpreted in user units, so dragging the slider paints a repeating dash pattern over the whole path instead of a 50% draw — an actively wrong rendering with no warning. Probe support up front; when absent, show the standard requires/flag banner and either fall back to the SVG pathLength ATTRIBUTE (which achieves the same normalisation everywhere) or to getTotalLength()-based values, clearly labelled as the fallback the property replaces.

openQuestions.title: Add the missing ChromeStatus reference link
openQuestions.detail: Invariant 3 requires chromestatus.com/feature/4861677550043136 on every page; this page's see-also has only sibling links.

openQuestions.title: Honour prefers-reduced-motion and announce draw progress
openQuestions.detail: The Animate button runs an 1.8s rAF loop regardless of prefers-reduced-motion, and progress is only visible visually/in the % span. Skip or shorten the animation under reduced motion and give the progress readout role=status.

openQuestions.title: Give the stage SVG a meaningful accessible name and shape-state
openQuestions.detail: Replace aria-label='Svg stage SVG graphic' with a name reflecting the current shape and drawn percentage (e.g. 'Heart path, 40% drawn'), and add aria-pressed to the shape selector buttons.

summary: Reviewed with the headless-Chromium-141 cloud fallback (not chrome-devtools-mcp): full-page screenshot + DOM of /v149/css-path-length/draw-on-path/ and the feature /conformance/ route (HTTP 200; in-page panel 2 pass / 4 fail / 0 blocked — path-length is genuinely unsupported in this browser). The demo itself is well built (shapes, sliders, animate, generated CSS with the keyframes idiom), but with the property absent the fallback behaviour is actively wrong (user-unit dash stripes) and undetected, and the page lacks its ChromeStatus anchor. Slider/animate interactions were not driven headless.
